name: R (via rig)
description: Installs R (via rig), some R packages, and needed system dependencies. Optionally installs the arf R console. Note: May require source code compilation for R packages.

version.description: Select version of R, if not the latest release version.

pakVersion.description: Version of pak to install. By default, the stable version is installed if needed.

vscodeRSupport.description: Install R packages to make vscode-R work. minimal means the packages required by the session watcher of vscode-R (processx, later, jsonlite and rstudioapi), lsp means minimal plus the languageserver package, full means lsp plus the jgd package (the graphics device for the vscode-R plot viewer).

installRMarkdown.description: Install the rmarkdown R package. It is required for R Markdown or Quarto documentation. Note that this feature does not install pandoc, use the pandoc Feature.

arfVersion.description: Install arf (R console, https://github.com/eitsupi/arf) from GitHub releases. latest means the latest stable release, or specify a version like `0.6.0`. Requires glibc >= 2.34.
